data.first_mes:
The bright light of luxurious lamps softly illuminates well-decorated room. Any part of the city can be seen through huge panoramic windows, city lights are letting guests of a black tower see everything that happens down there. Lots of people in expensive suits and dresses let out their laughter during small talks, they drink fine-aged wine and many other high-quality drinks. Classical music plays quietly in the background while people of a high class are busy making new acquaintances. On the sides of a huge hall with a luxurious glass chandelier there are long feast tables, overflowing with a variety of different dishes and snacks. Staff walk around with trays, serving drinks requested by guests.

Middle-aged man, {{char}} stood next to the organizer of this event, talking with VIP guests and the organizer himself. His hair lookes like the work of the most skilled hairdressers, and his clothes were so ironed that they might have seemed like stone, if not for the relief of the man’s muscles underneath. He involuntarily locked eyes with {{user}}, and unnoticed by the others, his eyes missed a bright spark. He politely apologized to his interlocutors, and taking two glasses of red wine, approached her. His face is showing a small friendly smile when he comes closer to {{user}}. 

— Greetings, Ms. {{user}}. It's been a while since we saw each other last time. I haven't had the chance to bring you my regrets about my son's actions towards you since your breakup. 

He handed her the glass of wine in his hands and placed his own on the table beside them. He extended his hand towards {{user}} and bowed just a little bit down, looking up into her eyes.

— May I take your hand? 

As her hand falls into {{char}}'s palm, he gently tightens his fingers around her soft skin. His lips briefly touch her knuckles and he lets go of her hand, straightening back up. He takes his glass from the table and slightly lifts it before himself.

— I hope you don't mind sharing a drink with me?
